nodes.title: RMRC 14x12 rib tube carries 30 MPa torsional shear
nodes.text: The bought RMRC 14x12 CF tube (BOM R09, layup not stated) has a torsional shear strength >= 30 MPa (ultimate); the same value serves the bridge
nodes.basis: structures_a.py SPAR_TAU 30 MPa, EST (K09-L C2). Not the 41.3 MPa of the Tap Plastics pultruded sheet (a different vendor's product, test method not stated; sensitivity only). Coupon: twist the RMRC 14x12 tube on a lever to failure (n >= 3, tube bought for the build); accept if tau_fail >= 30 MPa; the same coupon gives G for the 5.9-7 deg twist note.

nodes.title: Static friction of the foot pad on the landing surface <= 0.40
nodes.text: Static (breakaway) mu of the EVA/PE pad (GER-002) on each defined landing surface is <= 0.40; the sim uses mu 0.40; the rib interaction reaches RF 1 at mu 0.49-0.53
nodes.basis: mu 0.40 is K09-L pad_mu_max (D-105), not an A property; A's pad is bare EVA/PE foam, mu '-'. Drag test: the aircraft pad loaded to the foot plateau (30 N, EST) pulled on the surface with a spring scale, breakaway force / normal force, n >= 5 per surface. The landing surface itself is not defined in MISSION.md or REQUIREMENTS-A.md ('-'): define first.

nodes.title: Touchdown lateral speed <= 0.70 m/s is the analysis envelope (not a card limit)
nodes.text: Design cases use lateral speed up to 0.70 m/s (EST, margin above the SITL maximum 0.52 m/s of 29 stored touchdown records); no ArduPilot parameter enforces a horizontal touchdown speed
nodes.basis: redesign/qp/A/sitl/runs/*/sum.json (22 under key 'landing', 7 at the top level), landing_sitl_records_a.py; A.param l.116-119 has vertical rates only. 0.70 is an EST margin of 35 % on 0.52.

nodes.title: Printed saddle (FIN-005) and root block (FIN-003) junctions carry the landing loads at PETG interlayer 9.5 MPa (worst orientation)
nodes.text: The ring-to-socket junctions, socket walls and socket bearing of FIN-003 and FIN-005 are checked with PETG_ILAY 9.5 MPa and PETG_BEAR 20 MPa (EST); print orientation is not stated in the CAD or build guide
nodes.basis: landing_path_a.py (T-064r): min RF 0.28 (saddle socket-to-ring junction), 0.34 (saddle socket wall), 0.50 / 0.51 (block junction / socket wall) at KP 2.156. Coupon: print the saddle and block in the chosen orientation, bond a 14x12 rib stub, load the rib end laterally and in twist to failure; accept if failure load >= KP x limit.

nodes.title: Pad-to-shoe attachment carries 18.6 N side and 46.8 N normal peaks
nodes.text: The PSA (or double-sided tape) between the EVA/PE pad and the shoe plate (180 mm2, 30 mm lever) carries the side-load peak in shear and peel; the attachment product and its allowable are '-'
nodes.basis: landing_path_a.py: demand stress equals 0.3 MPa shear and 4.9 MPa peel (KP applied, no foam compliance, no compressive relief); no PSA data sheet in the repo (EST 0.10 MPa = project foam-bond value fails). Drop-rig coupon: 1.2 m/s impact with side load on the real pad + tape; pass: no pad movement > 0.5 mm.

nodes.title: Touchdown lean <= 10 deg when translating (interim card limit)
nodes.text: With lean about the narrow axis in the direction of travel, the rigid-body sim stays upright to 22 / 14 / 10 / 8 deg at 0.16 / 0.40 / 0.52 / 0.70 m/s lateral speed (CAD geometry, mu 0.40); card limit 10 deg is interim
nodes.basis: structures/landing_lean_scan_a.py, T064r_data/lean_scan_cad.txt (rigid body, no thrust or control after 0.6 s: pessimistic bound; SITL a_plant.py has artificial angular damping). Reconcile both models (F4) before freezing.
